name: marquee
useFor: Use under the hero's actions for the stores, customers or partners a product reaches; LogoStrip wraps it for marks. Use at most one per page.
constraints: Logos in color on the strip
Two running strips on one page
Text a reader must read to act
documentation:
`Marquee` props: `items` (ReactNode[]), `label` (the list's accessible name), `duration` (seconds a lap, default 100),
plus div props. The items take the strip's grey through currentColor.
title: Marquee
description: A slow strip of grey marks or names drifting left, fading at both ends, paused under the pointer.
